summary: Sphere 3D filed an 8-K reporting two definitive asset-sale agreements signed September 1, 2026. It agreed to sell its Iowa site to Simple Mining, LLC for $1.5 million, receiving $300,000 cash plus a $1.2 million interest-free promissory note payable in equal monthly installments from December 1, 2026 through November 1, 2027; the sublease terminated, equipment assigned, and roughly $525,000 in prepayments and deposits returned. Separately, a binding term sheet with RepairBit, LLC covers all ~5,500 owned mining machines for ~$3.1 million over 90 days, with title retained until paid. Watch collection risk and residual cash runway.
